WRIT 105AI.heading: Writing 105AI. Writing and Generative AI
WRIT 105AI.name: Writing and Generative AI
WRIT 105AI.description: Writing with generative AI is examined through strategic communication, reflection, knowledge development and ethical decisions in academic, civic and professional settings.
WRIT 105AI.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 105CD.heading: Writing 105CD. Writing with Code
WRIT 105CD.name: Writing with Code
WRIT 105CD.description: Students design and analyze works combining writing and code, including interactive narratives, web documents, games and data visualizations; prior coding is unnecessary.
WRIT 105CD.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units. No prior coding experience necessary.

WRIT 105CW.heading: Writing 105CW. Writing in Community
WRIT 105CW.name: Writing in Community
WRIT 105CW.description: Community-based writing develops reports and proposals through local engagement, research and attention to genres and writing conventions.
WRIT 105CW.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 105M.heading: Writing 105M. Multimedia Writing
WRIT 105M.name: Multimedia Writing
WRIT 105M.description: Multimedia composition studies rhetorical choices across digital platforms and produces work for varied public audiences and genres.
WRIT 105M.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 105PD.heading: Writing 105PD. Writing for Public Discourse
WRIT 105PD.name: Writing for Public Discourse
WRIT 105PD.description: Civic writing is studied through public policy, activism and public discourse, with research and composition in varied geographical contexts.
WRIT 105PD.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 105PS.heading: Writing 105PS. Writing for Public Speaking
WRIT 105PS.name: Writing for Public Speaking
WRIT 105PS.description: Public speaking combines research and writing with oral delivery, speech scripts, visual materials and audience-specific presentations.
WRIT 105PS.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 105S.heading: Writing 105S. Writing About Sustainability
WRIT 105S.name: Writing About Sustainability
WRIT 105S.description: Students research sustainability and communicate its concepts through writing and images for interdisciplinary audiences.
WRIT 105S.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 105SW.heading: Writing 105SW. Science Writing for the Public
WRIT 105SW.name: Science Writing for the Public
WRIT 105SW.description: Students communicate scientific research and findings to nonspecialists using traditional and newer media.
WRIT 105SW.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 107B.heading: Writing 107B. Business and Administrative Writing
WRIT 107B.name: Business and Administrative Writing
WRIT 107B.description: Business writing practices audience strategy, concise prose and visual communication through correspondence, proposals and collaborative reports.
WRIT 107B.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 107EP.heading: Writing 107EP. Writing for Environmental Professions
WRIT 107EP.name: Writing for Environmental Professions
WRIT 107EP.description: Environmental professional writing addresses research, audience, document design, collaboration and editing in areas such as water and sustainability.
WRIT 107EP.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units. Page identifies this course as formerly Writing109ES; current equivalence/credit handling across both degree-listed codes is not inferred.

WRIT 107G.heading: Writing 107G. Professional Writing for Global Careers
WRIT 107G.name: Professional Writing for Global Careers
WRIT 107G.description: Writing for global organizations addresses international research, linguistic and cultural factors, and professional correspondence and reports.
WRIT 107G.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 107J.heading: Writing 107J. Journalism and News Writing
WRIT 107J.name: Journalism and News Writing
WRIT 107J.description: Journalistic writing develops interviewing, research, editing, deadline practice and ethical judgment for print and broadcast news.
WRIT 107J.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 107L.heading: Writing 107L. Legal Writing
WRIT 107L.name: Legal Writing
WRIT 107L.description: Legal writing applies rules to facts and develops clear analysis in briefs, essays, correspondence and memoranda, with introductory legal research.
WRIT 107L.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 107M.heading: Writing 107M. Magazine Writing for Publication
WRIT 107M.name: Magazine Writing for Publication
WRIT 107M.description: Magazine writing develops interviews, reviews and articles, considering audience, genre, editing, deadlines and submission for publication.
WRIT 107M.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 107T.heading: Writing 107T. Technical Writing
WRIT 107T.name: Technical Writing
WRIT 107T.description: Technical communication develops user instructions, manuals and online documentation through task analysis, design and writing strategies.
WRIT 107T.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 107WC.heading: Writing 107WC. Writing Web Content
WRIT 107WC.name: Writing Web Content
WRIT 107WC.description: Professional web writing develops websites, blogs, newsletters and social-media content using strategies suited to digital communication.
WRIT 107WC.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 109ED.heading: Writing 109ED. Writing for the Teaching Professions
WRIT 109ED.name: Writing for the Teaching Professions
WRIT 109ED.description: Writing for teaching professions examines issues in educational theory, practice and policy through research, discussion and analysis.
WRIT 109ED.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 109HP.heading: Writing 109HP. Writing for Health Professionals
WRIT 109HP.name: Writing for Health Professionals
WRIT 109HP.description: Health-profession writing studies academic and professional genres through research and communication about contemporary health issues.
WRIT 109HP.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 109ST.heading: Writing 109ST. Writing for Science and Technology
WRIT 109ST.name: Writing for Science and Technology
WRIT 109ST.description: Scientific and technical writing develops reports, proposals, articles and abstracts through research, document and graphic design, style and editing.
WRIT 109ST.prerequisites: Writing2,2E or2LK; upper-division standing. Introductory page additionally specifies AreaA1 completion and at least90recorded units.

WRIT 1.heading: Writing 1. Approaches to University Writing
WRIT 1.name: Approaches to University Writing
WRIT 1.description: University writing develops critical reading, increasingly complex essays and a reflective composition process for academic participation.
WRIT 1.prerequisites: No credit after English1, Writing1E or1LK.

WRIT 1E.heading: Writing 1E. Approaches to University Writing for Engineers
WRIT 1E.name: Approaches to University Writing for Engineers
WRIT 1E.description: Academic writing for engineers develops critical reading and analysis through engineering and technology topics, including engineering ethics.

WRIT 2.heading: Writing 2. Academic Writing
WRIT 2.name: Academic Writing
WRIT 2.description: Academic writing develops critical inquiry, genre awareness, reading and analytical strategies through intensive feedback and revision.
WRIT 2.prerequisites: UC Entry Level Writing Requirement satisfied; no credit after English2, Writing2LK or2E.

WRIT 2E.heading: Writing 2E. Academic Writing for Engineers
WRIT 2E.name: Academic Writing for Engineers
WRIT 2E.description: Academic writing for engineers adds technical reports, memos, collaborative documents and multimedia presentations to academic-writing practice.
WRIT 2E.prerequisites: College of Engineering enrollment; this local block does not independently restate the WRIT2 entry rule.

WRIT 50.heading: Writing 50. Writing and the Research Process
WRIT 50.name: Writing and the Research Process
WRIT 50.description: Students propose and complete an independent research project, developing sustained inquiry, synthesis and longer academic writing.
WRIT 50.prerequisites: Not open to seniors. Writing2,2E,2LK or equivalent; no credit after English3, Writing50LK or50E.

WRIT 50E.heading: Writing 50E. Writing and the Research Process for Engineers
WRIT 50E.name: Writing and the Research Process for Engineers
WRIT 50E.description: Engineering research writing emphasizes collaborative inquiry and teamwork for professional engineering communication.
WRIT 50E.prerequisites: College of Engineering enrollment; this local block does not independently restate the WRIT50 prerequisite.
